notes.title: Update v0.49
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!

So after your votes there was a tie between Pop, Hip Hop and Rock. So we have added songs to each of them.

♫ Roll Like That by Ashley Jana Mounts added to Pop/Dance genre.
♫ The Man by Greame B. Samuels, Suzette Ferrell, Nigel Roberts, Silas Carty added to R&B/Hip Hop genre.
♫ Don't Give Up by Neil Cross added to Rock/Metal genre.
♫ Poll box reseted.

notes.title: Update v0.46
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!


With this update; 

♫ Audio VFX added for note misses.

♫ Notes not appearing correctly at "Idiocracy" song's master level bug fixed.

♫ Players with private Steam profile are also have private accounts ingame but leaderboard scores and
rankings are still visible.

♫ An icon will appear on leaderboard label if it is you.

♫ Performance improvements made.

notes.title: Update v0.35
notes.content:
Hello music lovers!


With this update; 

♫ Highest rating, max strike, highscore and max notes hit values are seperated by difficulty. Bad news is; these values and your unlocked songs are reseted. We are sorry about that but your online profile values like stats, achievements and leaderboard scores are protected.

♫ UI pop up for beat power collection added.

♫ Some song names not appearing correctly bug fixed.

notes.title: Tune the Tone is available now!
notes.content:
After a lot of hard work, Tune the Tone is here!
We believe Tune the Tone became a great music/rhythm game and we still have a long journey ahead of us.

Through early access; 
♫ Songs will be added and you will select the genre of the songs from ingame poll box. 
♫ Custom editor that you can create your own levels with the songs you like will be added.

Thank you for your support and attention to Tune the Tone so far. 
Specially thanks to great artists that provided us these great songs and to our playtesters that helped us developing a great rhythm game!

notes.title: Tune the Tone is coming out!
notes.content:
Last 2 days!
We are very excited about the launch! [b]Thank you again for all the support so far.[/b]

So PC Early Access launch is 2 days away but Mac support is delayed.

We are sorry about it but due to Covid situation everything slowed down a bit.

notes.title: Tune the Tone is now available for wishlisting!
notes.content:
We have been working really hard for this day. We want to build a great community around Tune the Tone with your help. Thank you for your attention and support.

EA launch will be very soon and exact date will be announced.
